decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 2 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of  08.00 to 18.00 on Mondays to Friday and 09.00  to 13.00 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - The standby generators hereby approved shall only be used in the event of an emergency or when they need to be tested in accordance with scheduled maintenance requirements.

Condition : 4 - The level of noise emitted from the proposed plant (specified as chillers and standby generators)  shall not  be less than 5dB(A) below the existing background noise levels (LAeq) when measured over any 24 hour period at  the nearest noise sensitive receivers.
For the purposes of this condition the nearest noise sensitive receivers ahall be taken to be 379 Chiswick High Road, the flatted development known as Gunnersbury Close at the junction of Burlington Road /Chiswick High Road and 592 Chiswick High Road.
description: Following approval for erection of 2 storey studios - details submitted pursuant to condition 3 (amended plans) of planning permission ref 248/D11/P1 dated 8/10/2001 for erection of two recording studios as an extension to the rear of Building 11, the relocation ,at ground level, of a compactor and transformer enclosure to the existing building and the erection of two standby generators and three chillers on the roof of Building 11.
